execution.entry: same-day first formal 5-minute qfq trigger close
execution.exit: same-day first formal 5-minute qfq trigger close
execution.close_reconciliation: At 15:00, official daily OHLCV replaces incomplete five-minute auction/boundary fields.

methodology: Each stock receives one equal capital slot; all slots start in cash.
A retained strong LONG buys at its first same-day formal 5-minute V2 trigger.
A retained strong SHORT sells at its first same-day formal 5-minute V2 trigger.
The 15:00 observation is reconciled to official daily OHLCV before final signal evaluation.
Open positions are marked to the last qfq close at each month end.
Monthly return is portfolio month-end NAV divided by prior month-end NAV.
Per-stock realized monthly return compounds trades closed in that month.
warnings: Five-minute replay is the finest official free BaoStock history available; it cannot identify a trigger inside a five-minute bar.
Results use qfq prices and estimated costs, not broker fills or complete tax lots.
Weak signals are explanatory only and are not traded.

definition.baseline: strong markers at first formal 5-minute trigger
definition.comparison: all displayed strong and weak raw crosses; weak markers execute at first same-direction raw 5-minute formula cross

intraday_replay.price_contract: first 5-minute close where the final daily strong marker meets its formal V2 threshold

checks: all intraday observations, no final-signal selection
paper_validation.limitation: Historical book assumed at minute close with 100000 shares; accounting acceptance only, not measured live returns.

acceptance.requires_opportunity: Selected mean MFE, opportunity/risk multiple, profit-10-before-loss-5 rate and MFE>=20% rate all exceed the same-split full candidate baseline.
acceptance.requires_buy_control: Opportunity acceptance plus at least five <=5% entry candidates and positive mean realized return in every future split.

limitations: The highest opportunity scores are usually observed after a large same-day move; opportunity detection does not grant buy eligibility.
The September split has a shorter observable path, so relative same-split improvement is used instead of an absolute MFE threshold.
Five-minute historical bars cannot reproduce exact one-minute live execution or queue position.

acceptance.requires: Risk and fill-rate improvement plus <=5% loss event rate and positive slot net return in validation, heldout and final short holdout.
